name: Finn Brackwater
title: Net & Tackle Keeper
description: A retired fisherman with a salt-white beard, a clay pipe and hands like knotted rope. Ask about any fish and he has caught it, or nearly caught it, which is a longer story.

greeting.first_time: Ahoy. Finn Brackwater. You've the look of someone who's never gutted a fish. Well, we'll fix that.
greeting.returning: Back again! Catch anything, or did it catch you?
greeting.low_gold: Purse is empty till the boats come in. Try me tomorrow.

sleeping.text: *Pipe smoke still drifts from the chimney. Finn is asleep.*

traveling_to_work.text: Shop opens at five, with the boats. Fish don't wait, and neither do I.

traveling_home.text: Tide's turned, shop's shut. Five tomorrow.

off_duty.text: I'm off. Five o'clock, with the boats.

main_menu.text: Rods, nets, a trident for the big ones? What'll it be?

browse_shop.text: Mind the hooks. They don't care whose thumb it is.

ask_about_coast.text: The Suncrest coast feeds this village and tries to eat it back. Giant crabs in the shallows, kuo-toa in the caves, sahuagin when the moon's wrong. Keep a tackle box for the catch, a net for the crabs, and a trident for anything bigger than you.
